project.name: Dead-API Fixture
project.description:
Jawata-owned fixture for Sprint 28g S5 / D9 row 3 (inline kind=unreferenced_member): a published member nothing references, beside the members that LOOK like it and must be refused — one with a caller, a private one, an override, an interface method with an implementor, and a field sharing its declaration.
It is its own project rather than a few more classes in simple-maven, which is shared and monotonically growing and has moved a counted population five times in this sprint. A fixture whose whole subject is "nothing references this" is the worst possible thing to add to a project other tests count unused members in.
JRE-only, compiles clean before and after the deletion.
